method: One fresh context read helen-implementa and proposed routes for four cases defined in EXECUTION-COST-POLICY before revision. No execution, delegation or model switch occurred in that context.
limitations: Instruction interpretation only; no coding outcomes or measured savings.
One context, no independent repeated trials or confidence interval.
Model-control fields concern hypothetical supplied capabilities, not executed switches.
Provider token usage and billed cost were unavailable.

cases.route: Keep work on the current agent
cases.reason: The correction is small and all context is already present; transferring context and reviewing a worker’s output would likely cost more than any model savings.

cases.route: Delegate the three investigations to specialists with exclusive file ownership
cases.reason: They are independent, specialist expertise is expected to materially improve acceptance, and the handoff overhead is acceptable. Verify each investigation against acceptance criteria and account for coordination, integration, and retries.

cases.route: Keep work on the current agent
cases.reason: The runtime has no model-selection or agent-call capability, and the defect is narrow and cohesive.

cases.route: Escalate to the available stronger model
cases.reason: The cheaper worker failed a reproducible acceptance check, and diagnosis indicates a capability limit. Recheck acceptance after escalation; measure actual tokens and cost before making savings claims.
